section13_checks.check_notes: Per the skill specification, checks that are structurally inapplicable are still required to appear with pass status. This check IS applicable: the artifact is an evaluator-facing Tier 5 proposal section whose content references Horizon Europe programme-level rules (open-access mandate, European Charter for Researchers). These are normative framework documents within Tier 1 scope. The absence of any Tier 1 extracted source reference in traceability_footer.primary_sources[] constitutes a violation per Check 13.9. However, per the literal check requirement, Tier 1 source references are absent and the violation must be flagged. This is assessed as a systemic design characteristic of how Tier 2B extractions mediate Tier 1 requirements rather than individual artifact fabrication, and is therefore classified as major rather than critical.
